verdict.rationale: Terraform's state and module system (terraform-docs-20, terraform-docs-33, terraform-docs-13) supports separating configuration into reusable modules and remote state per environment, which is the underlying mechanism for dev/staging/prod separation, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents the `terraform workspace` command or a documented pattern for separate environment stacks. Missing for 10: explicit docs on `terraform workspace new/select`, guidance on directory-per-environment or workspace-per-environment patterns, and independent confirmation of how teams structure environments.
